'''Mimetaster''' is an [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] [[vermin]] from the [[wikipedia:Devonian|Devonian]] era, found in [[temperate]] [[ocean]]s and saltwater [[pool]]s. They might be{{verify|they might not be big enough}} usable for the [[fishing industry]], but only by [[Fishery|capturing a live fish]], rather than normal fishing, and also [[Kitchen|cookable]] without cleaning.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] mimetaster for their ''tilted walk''.
